historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover Sport P400e - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the P400e launched in the L494 Range Rover Sport, it introduced a plug-in hybrid powertrain combining a 2.0-litre Ingenium petrol engine with a 105kW electric motor, delivering 404hp and up to 40km of electric-only range for lower emissions and urban driving efficiency.

milestones.description: AJ200P (2.0L Petrol PHEV, 404hp combined) introduced to the Range Rover Sport L494, offering lower Benefit-in-Kind (BIK) tax and zero-emission capability for short journeys.
Minor software and thermal management updates to the P400e powertrain to improve charging reliability and electric motor integration.
P400e phased out in the Range Rover Sport, replaced by the more powerful P510e (3.0L PHEV) in the new L461 generation.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover Sport P400e is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Sport P400e Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The AJ200P plug-in hybrid powertrain dominating the Range Rover Sport P400e offers excellent efficiency, but its complex integration of combustion and electric systems introduces specific failure points. Rebuilt AJ200P engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Charging System & Combustion Engine Wear - Why the Range Rover Sport P400e AJ200P Requires Specialist Attention
problems.rootCause: The 13.1kWh battery pack and AC-DC converter can develop faults over time, leading to reduced electric range or failure to charge. This forces the 2.0L petrol engine to work harder and more frequently, exposing its inherent susceptibility to timing chain stretch and injector coking.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: High-voltage system diagnostics, AC-DC converter repair, and battery module balancing.
repairOptions.longevity: Suitable if the 2.0L combustion engine remains healthy and shows no timing chain rattle.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a fully rebuilt AJ200P combustion unit with updated timing chain kit, verified hybrid integration, and a 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the combustion engine has suffered timing chain failure or severe wear from overuse due to battery depletion.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Modern Range Rover Sport L494 P400e values typically range from £18,000 to £35,000+ depending on specification, mileage, and service history [THIRD-PARTY]. Because the vehicle worth is well above £15,000, a £4,500-£7,500 rebuilt engine replacement cost is typically small relative to the vehicle value ( Safe). Replacing the engine preserves the vehicle's usability, hybrid efficiency, and strong market value.
problems.recommendation: If your Range Rover Sport P400e is only showing reduced electric range or minor charging faults but the 2.0L combustion engine runs smoothly, a specialist high-voltage system diagnostic and repair is the most cost-effective route. However, if the combustion engine has developed timing chain rattle or suffered wear from constant use due to a depleted battery, a full rebuilt unit is the only reliable long-term solution.

items.question: How much does a Range Rover Sport P400e engine replacement cost?
items.answer: A reconditioned or rebuilt AJ200P engine for the Range Rover Sport P400e typically costs between £4,500 and £7,500 for the supply-only unit in the UK.
keyPoints: Used AJ200P engines start around £3,500 but carry higher risk due to unknown hybrid system history.
Rebuilt units with updated timing components sit at the £4,500-£7,500 mark.
Supply and fit labour will add £650-£910 depending on the specialist.
items.cta: -> Get free quotes for your Range Rover Sport P400e engine replacement.

items.question: What are the signs of engine or hybrid system failure in a Range Rover Sport P400e?
items.answer: The AJ200P powertrain can exhibit both electrical and mechanical warning signs. Watch for early indicators before catastrophic failure.
keyPoints: Significantly reduced electric-only range or failure to charge via the AC port.
Rough running or excessive vibration when the battery is depleted and the 2.0L engine is solely responsible for propulsion.
A distinct metallic rattling noise from the engine bay on cold starts, indicating timing chain stretch.
items.cta: -> Compare specialist quotes to fix your Range Rover Sport P400e hybrid or engine issues.

items.question: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Sport P400e?
items.answer: Yes, the modern L494 Range Rover Sport P400e market holds its value well, making a full engine replacement a financially sound decision.
keyPoints: Modern P400e models regularly sell for £18,000 to £35,000+.
A £4,500-£7,500 rebuilt engine preserves the vehicle's drivability, hybrid efficiency, and market appeal.
items.cta: -> Check current Range Rover Sport P400e replacement costs.

items.question: How long does a Range Rover Sport P400e engine replacement take?
items.answer: Because the AJ200P is a complex plug-in hybrid powertrain, a specialist workshop requires hybrid-trained technicians and specific JLR diagnostic tools.
keyPoints: Engine removal, high-voltage system isolation, and refitting usually takes 12 to 16 hours of labour.
Total workshop turnaround is typically 3 to 5 working days, including ECU coding and hybrid system calibration.
items.cta: -> Find a local specialist for your Range Rover Sport P400e.

items.question: What is the difference between the Range Rover Sport P400e and P510e engines?
items.answer: While both are plug-in hybrids, the P510e (introduced in the L461 generation) is a significant upgrade over the P400e.
keyPoints: The P400e uses a 2.0-litre four-cylinder Ingenium petrol engine paired with a 105kW electric motor (404hp combined).

The P510e uses a 3.0-litre six-cylinder Ingenium petrol engine paired with a 105kW electric motor and a larger battery pack (510hp combined), offering significantly improved electric range and performance.
items.cta: -> Get quotes for the correct engine for your Range Rover Sport P400e.
